Atomic city/country+revision update preserves concurrent settings; unchanged commands avoid persistence. Pre-fix assertion fails; 5806 native checks, 4 real QEMU themes/8 city commands, and active-fade native frame with zero differing pixels pass. Factory blank defect retained only as observed evidence. See ../qemu/parity/city-reinit-validation-20261020.json; not full/24h/hardware acceptance.
Factory AP peer connect/disconnect starts/stops HTTP; native keeps one boot-scoped server. Avoid factory duplicate starts/service disappearance, but test simultaneous peers and zero->one reconnect.
Factory config enables output pull-ups on RESET/DC; native uses default disabled pulls. Driven SPI/frames do not validate floating/boot/reset electrical behavior.

NETWORK/SLOW timer latches, browser_time preference and clickCount have no operational consumer in selected app bodies. Native also retains unused settings_generation/display_text APIs. Requires full-image references before asserting factory dead code.
